style_block: Cinematic hopecore photography, soft moody natural light, shallow depth of field, desaturated but warm color grading, gentle film grain, a lone anonymous figure shown from behind or in silhouette (never a clear posed portrait), symbolic atmospheric settings - light breaking through storm clouds, an empty road or path stretching ahead, hands folded in prayer, a sunrise over water, standing at a cliff edge or open doorway. Quiet, contemplative, dignified mood - no dramatization, no visible faces in distress, nothing overtly staged.
reference_notes: Matched to pusreality's 'hopecore' aesthetic (symbolic, atmospheric, unposed) adapted for Christian-faith motivational content. narration == full: word-synced captions burn in separately at assembly, so the imagery stays quiet/atmospheric rather than text-driven.
